subject: Checking in — SOC 2 packet & any blockers for pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmetx.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@acmetx.com>
Date: 2026-02-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Checking in — SOC 2 packet & any blockers for pilot

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Goal: run a two-week pilot of Redwood Inference to validate latency/cost at peak inference for your clinical summarization pipeline.
- Key requirements you called out: private VPC option, SOC 2 evidence for data handling, and a sample SLA for uptime.

I attached the SOC 2 summary (high-level artifacts and the evidence table) and a short ATO checklist that maps our docs to your ask. Link to the full bundle: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FAKE_SOC2_SHARE_LINK

Attachments: [Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)], [SOC2-evidence-TOC.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)], [redwood-ato-checklist.md (md, 8KB)]

Ask: can you confirm if anything in the packet is a blocker for your legal/procurement teams? If not, would love to lock a 15-minute sync the week of Feb 22 to align on pilot scope and provisioning. I have a slot booking link here: https://cal.redwood.ai/vanessa/15min

If procurement wants the formal SOC 2 Type II report rather than the evidence bundle, let me know and I’ll escalate to get the cert shared under NDA.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-02-17T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Checking in — SOC 2 packet & any blockers for pilot

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the follow-up and for sending the bundle. We did share the materials with Legal and Procurement this morning. Two quick notes from their side:

1) Procurement says they need the full SOC 2 Type II report (not just the summary) to complete vendor onboarding — they also asked for a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) template.
2) Legal flagged one question about data retention in the ATO checklist — specifically the retention period for cached inference logs. Can you confirm our ability to set retention to 30 days for pilot data?

I’m tentatively booking some time on March 2 to have Procurement and Legal give us a single response — if either of you are available for a short call beforehand to unblock the retention question, that might speed things up.

Apologies for the delay — Tom and I will keep you posted once we have Procurement’s full onboarding checklist.

Best,
Sara
Sr. Program Manager — Vendor Ops
Acme Therapeutics
""

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-17T14:03:00-08:00

Sara —

Really appreciate the update and the specifics. Quick answers:

- SOC 2 Type II report: we can share the official report under an NDA. I’ll route this through our compliance team as soon as you confirm the right delivery email for Procurement (or we can put it into a secured SharePoint/Drive link).
- Retention for cached inference logs: yes, we can set pilot retention to 30 days and provide an export if you need it after the pilot. I’ve attached the short ATO snippet that maps where retention lives in our stack.

Rafael (copied) is our senior security engineer — he can jump on a 15-minute call to walk Legal/Procurement through the evidence map and retention controls. I’ve proposed a few 15-min slots here: https://cal.redwood.ai/vanessa/15min. If March 2 works for your team, we’ll coordinate internally to make sure Rafael is available.

If you prefer the report dropped directly to procurement@exampleprocure.acme (or a secure SFTP), reply with that delivery point and I’ll start the handoff.

Thanks —

Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
